name: Smart Globe Holdings Limited
summary: Smart Globe Holdings Limited is an investment holding company, a subsidiary of Master Sage Limited, that creates, prints and distributes books, novelty items and packaging. It has been based in North Point since 2012 and sells to customers in Hong Kong, the United States, Britain, the Netherlands, Australia, China and France. Its work spans pre-press, printing and finishing, and its products include boxes, pop-up children's books, journals, stationery and photo albums.
